title: Borromean insertions steer the twisted triple product
claim: Let M be a closed oriented 3-manifold with a surjection psi: pi1 M -> C3, V = H^1(M; F4_{w^2}) and T the twisted triple product of TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001A. Let Gamma be a Y-graph in M whose three leaves l1, l2, l3 lie in ker psi, and M' the result of Y-surgery (Borromean surgery) along Gamma. Then H1(M') = H1(M) canonically, psi extends, V' = V, and T' = T + l1 ^ l2 ^ l3, where l_j(a) = c_a(l_j) evaluates a cocycle on the based leaf and (l1 ^ l2 ^ l3)(a, b, c) is the determinant of the 3 x 3 matrix (l_i(a), l_i(b), l_i(c)). Every F4-linear functional on V is some l_j, so the forms realized from M by Y-surgeries with leaves in ker psi include T + A for every alternating F4-trilinear form A on V. If M = S^3_3(K) and each Y-graph has a leaf bounding a small disk that meets only K, the result is S^3_3(K') for a knot K'. In the braid model, inserting the 3-cabled Borromean braid (s1 s2^-1)^3 on three bundles of three adjacent strands adds exactly l1 ^ l2 ^ l3, with l_j the right-to-left product of bundle j's arcs.
failure_conditions: A Borromean insertion whose obstruction kernels differ, for some first argument a, from those predicted by T + l1 ^ l2 ^ l3.
Two or three insertions whose effects do not add with the same constant.
An insertion that changes H1 or the cocycle space read on the top arcs.
A control that cannot fail: the left-to-right leaf convention, or a wrong relative scalar between two insertions, must mismatch.
foundation_claim_scope: Closed oriented 3-manifolds with a surjection to C3. Cited, not proved: Massuyeau's Y-surgery formula for triple cup products with Z/n coefficients (AGT 3 (2003), Lemma 3.2; Turaev, Matveev), that Y-surgery preserves H1 and the linking pairing (Matveev 1987), and Habiro's clasper calculus identifying a cabled Borromean insertion with Y-surgery along a clasper whose leaves encircle the bundles. The twisted statement is derived here by lifting to the 3-fold cover. Checked exactly on knots built from figure-eight and trefoil connected sums. No complexity claim; no P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: exact kernel comparison on 20 single insertions, 4 multiple insertions and 2 insertions over a nonzero base form, with failing controls; theorem via Massuyeau's Lemma 3.2 lifted to the 3-fold cover; no human or external review
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-26.
